scope: Independent JSON and IEEE-754 binary32 comparison, no rerender, no acoustic-match claim. The prior_c4_export is byte-identical to the previously checked c4 export; c4 itself changed DSP only.

previous_c4_description_changes.name: Velvet FX 138
previous_c4_description_changes.before: A broad low wind bed supports a separate airy gust that arrives later. Shallow SUB motion avoids a regular throbbing cycle; pressure brings forward the upper air and the unequal releases let it subside. A covered upper register and rounded main release, preserving the shorter edge.
previous_c4_description_changes.after: An airy gust enters first as a broader low wind bed blooms underneath. Shallow SUB motion adds gentle movement; pressure brings forward the upper air, and its shorter release lets it subside ahead of the low bed. A covered upper register and rounded main release, preserving the shorter edge.
